title: Free options trading data institutions pay for, on one screen
description:
Free options app: https://www.signumhq.com/app?src=yt_ad1

Max pain, gamma flip, whale flow and dark pool volume, on one screen for any US stock.

Max pain is the price where the most option contracts expire worthless. Gamma flip is where dealers stop cushioning a move and start amplifying it. Whale flow is the size institutions are actually moving. Dark pool is the volume nobody sees.

Claude reads the whole options book down to one line, so you get a verdict instead of a wall of numbers. Morning and closing briefings every trading day.

All of it free, on iOS and Android.

___
Most watched on this channel:
- Chip Stocks: $10,000 in AMD vs Intel, 10 Years Later
- Chip Stocks: Who Actually Got Rich in 10 Years
- Chip Stocks: $10,000 in NVIDIA vs Intel, 10 Years Later

Informational only. Not investment advice.
